resources.string: Hush Unpacker

Facebook\'s builds for Android 9 and 10 pack most of their code into one store that Morphe Manager can\'t read. Pick the Facebook APK or .apkm you downloaded for this phone. Hush Unpacker opens the store with Facebook\'s own library, checks every file against the build\'s list, and hands the copy to Morphe Manager to patch.
Pick a Facebook APK or bundle
Save the unpacked copy
